Lack of KB alone is not a physical contradiction. Matrix compilation and n/r/k are program tasks, not audit tasks. The listed provisional zero coordinates were null in the Analyzer response. This analysis uses ONLY the following 6 physical quantities as input parameters: 
the wall-normal distance (y), the wall density (ρ_w), the coefficient μ_w relating viscous shear stress to the wall-normal velocity gradient at the wall, the fluid density (ρ), the dynamic viscosity (μ), and the friction velocity (u_tau). 
To ensure comparability with the log-law and uniqueness of results, the power of wall units must be constrained to 1 for the INPUT and 0 for the OUTPUT formula.
